title: Public API PATCH refuses another entry number and a core rename
custom_preconds: API key with parts:write. Part P; entry E2 number N2; core part of P.
custom_steps:
1. PATCH /api/v1/parts/{P} {"part_number":"N2"}
  2. PATCH /api/v1/parts/{P} {"name":" "}
  3. PATCH the core part with a new part_number
  4. PATCH P with a valid new number, then open part history
custom_expected:
1. 409 {"error":{"code":"conflict","message":"Part number N2 already belongs to another part in the Part Library."}}
  2. 422
  3. 422 "A core follows its part. Rename the part instead."
  4. 200; history entry ends "| Changed through: Public API"
